Quick technical note —

We should avoid a regular SAML transient session because our IdP assertion TTL (60s) plus relying-party clock skew has caused 401s for auditors in the past. Proposed approach:

- Create a single-use JWT invite tied to the auditor email; TTL = 48h from issuance.
- Enforce IP allowlist at the Trust Proxy layer (we can accept CIDR up to /16).
- Enable read-only by default but grant "evidence bundle download" scope for the invite so auditors can download zip exports.
- Add an audit-invite-token.txt file to the invite with the token fingerprint — auditors can paste it into the portal if the SSO redirect fails.

Example recommended IP ranges to permit temporarily (please confirm with Samantha): [34.82.0.0/16, 18.205.0.0/16]. We will log all sessions and export access logs.

Also Marissa — once Vanessa confirms the dates, can you prepare the bridge letter draft? I copied our internal template link in the metadata; it's a short paragraph confirming no control changes since 2027-12-31 through the access window.

Attachments: audit-invite-token.txt (single-use token info)

—Rishi
